main_text.p: hi reddēda eft.Depulfio præ donis,Imò mihi.Q.utri red-denda fit.R.quia lex iubet de pofitum ei qui depofuit, red-di: & mihi qui tecum cōtra-xi,iure obligatus es. F. At æ-quitas poftulat, ut res quæq; domino potius, quàm latro-ni reftituatur. D.An cum lex depofitū ei qui depofuit red di iubeat,tamen quia qui de-pofuit,prædo eft:qui repetit, dominus, melius fit domino quàm latroni reddere. Try-phoninus in L. bona fides, 31. D. depofiti: Et probo in-quit,hanc effe iufticiam, quæ fuum cuique ita tribuit , ut nõ diftrahatur ab ullius per-fo-

page.notes: The running head at the top is set in heavy decorative type and is not legible; only a Roman numeral "III." appears to precede it. Speaker labels Q., R., F. and D. are printed in the dialogue and are kept as they stand. The left margin shows only specks and a small printed ornament beside "dominus", which is not text and is not transcribed. The last line "fo-" is a hyphenated word break and continues on the next page.
